# CONFORMANCE

The conformance ID register. Every test name ends in its ID; a test whose
ID is not listed here fails `cargo xtask check-model`, and so does an ID
listed here with no scenario and no test (`CM-02`).

The three honesty levels (R2):

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `some-true` | A fact reproduced from an authority. **Not established here.** |
| `build` | Constructed here and validated against its oracle. Evidence, not a proof. |
| `open` | Measured and reported. **Never asserted.** |

`cargo xtask audit-limits` fails if any code path returns an error the
model does not sanction.

## kernel

| ID | Level | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HK-01` | `build` | A missing repository and a private repository get the same answer: repository not found, with no source and no ETag |
| `HK-02` | `build` | The kernel delivers a file only for a public repository at a resolved revision whose entry exists, and names a source and an ETag exactly when it delivers |
| `HK-03` | `build` | The edge runner only ever redirects and the local runner only ever serves |
| `HK-04` | `build` | The edge runner never redirects to a source that is not vetted |
| `HK-05` | `build` | A delivered file always has a source, and the kernel never chooses a source that does not hold the file or that failed verification for it |
| `HK-06` | `build` | A pinned source is the only source the kernel may choose |
| `HK-07` | `build` | Without a pin, the kernel chooses a healthy source whenever a usable one exists |
| `HK-08` | `build` | A delivered small file carries the git blob ETag and a delivered large file carries the SHA-256 ETag |
| `HK-09` | `build` | A commit prefix resolves only when it is 7 to 40 characters long and matches the release's commit |
| `HK-10` | `build` | Received bytes are delivered exactly when their digest and size equal the expected digest and size |
| `HK-11` | `build` | Every header item and every link that stays in the hub opens a screen the kernel renders |
| `HK-12` | `build` | A Hugging Face tool sees no HTTP error exactly when the kernel delivers, and every refusal reaches it as a 4xx or 5xx status with a named error code |
| `HK-13` | `build` | The page says Verified only when at least one source delivered and none sent other bytes, and any source that sent other bytes makes the verdict a mismatch |
| `HK-14` | `build` | A model page says Witnessed or Published only when every signature check passed, says Published only for a publisher's signature from the namespace owner, and never shows a witness's signature as a publisher's |
